name: Ngheu Khai Long
summary: Nghêu Khai Long is the clam of the Khai Long flat. The cape board says the meat is thick and not sandy, and that the flat is busiest after Tết through the end of May and June.
origin: Bãi Khai Long. The management board’s pot is nghêu hấp sả.
howToEat: Set lemongrass and crushed ginger under the clams, chili if you want it, until the shells open.
Eat them hot with muối tiêu chanh or nước mắm chua ngọt.
where: Bãi Khai Long, on the cape day. No stall is named. Check on arrival for a price.
seoTitle: Ngheu Khai Long — clams after Tet
seoDescription: Nghêu Khai Long is the clam of the flat beside the cape, steamed with lemongrass and ginger. The busy harvest is after Tết through May and June.
